title: The Pollinator Covenant
logline: An elderly apiary keeper's thirty-year covenant to loan her genetic-stabilized honeybee hives to a public orchard is demanded by industrial fruit greenhouses facing crop abortion.

roles.description: Master hive breeder; protective, slow-spoken, refusing to stress her fragile zero-g bee colonies.
Keeper of the station's communal heritage apple garden; desperate, watching blossoms wither unpollinated.
Manager of an intensive agro-dome feeding four thousand workers; aggressive, citing economic food supply quotas.
The citizen cooperative preserving the station's founding public fruit grove.
A micro-gravity geodesic dome filled with flowering clover and temperature-regulated hives.
A massive multi-tiered industrial orchard complex where fruit trees are grown under high-intensity ultraviolet arcs.

public_situation: Citizen picketers gather outside {role:apiary_vault} as commercial fruit conglomerates demand the immediate requisition of the station's only surviving zero-g pollinator colonies.
private_truth: The breeder's surviving honeybee hives are too biologically fragile to pollinate both orchards, and dividing the worker population will trigger queen colony collapse.

beats.public_change: Orange quarantine tape closes off access corridors to {role:apiary_vault} as acoustic sensors record agitated hive buzzing.

missions.reason: Scan blossom drop rates across the commercial dome to prove whether mechanical brush pollination has failed.
missions.private_fact: The commercial grower cut corners by replacing manual hand-pollination crews with automated blowers that stripped the flowers.

beats.public_change: Temperature alarms ring across the apiary dome as station maintenance reduces environmental power subsidies.

missions.reason: Mine and deliver pure water ice to maintain delicate evaporative humidity blankets around the queen brood chambers.
missions.private_fact: Splitting the hive will divide the worker density below the critical threshold needed to survive the upcoming molt.

beats.public_change: Bailiffs and commercial agronomists arrive with sealed transit crates to seize the hive racks by administrative warrant.

missions.reason: Transport the insulated queen transit carrier to the commercial dome before the blossom window closes forever.
missions.private_fact: The matron signed an emergency mutual-aid covenant thirty years ago when the commercial syndicate funded her initial breeding stock.

player_choice.prompt: The blossom window lasts forty-eight hours. The bees cannot serve both orchards without queen exhaustion. The pilot holds the transport carrier.

options.label: Honor the public covenant and release the hives into the citizen apple grove to protect community heritage
Deliver the hives to the commercial agro-dome to secure bulk fruit calories for the station workforce
Rotate the hives on a grueling forty-eight-hour split shift, accepting high worker bee mortality to save both crops

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the colonies exclusively to the citizen orchard.
resolutions.summary: The public orchard yields a lush fruit harvest. The commercial agro-dome suffers total crop failure, driving basic food prices to record highs.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defied corporate agronomists to ensure century-old heritage apple trees received pollination.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the hives to the high-yield commercial greenhouse.
resolutions.summary: The commercial dome produces bumper fruit rations. The heritage grove withers barren, and {role:apiary_matron} mourns twenty collapsed hives.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot enforces a grueling split-shift rotation between both groves.
resolutions.summary: Both orchards bear partial fruit crops. Half the worker bees perish from exhaustion, but the queen lines survive and both growers share the loss.

resolutions.reached_by: The pollination window expires without agreement or intervention.
resolutions.summary: The dispute drags out past the bloom window. Unpollinated blossoms drop across both domes, causing catastrophic sector fruit shortages.

loose_threads.detail: The thirty-year apiary charter carries an unexecuted foreclosure clause held by a corporate agricultural holding group.
A crate of concentrated synthetic queen pheromone arrived on station with falsified safety certificates from an outer rim lab.
Advance delivery contracts for heritage cider and fresh pears were dumped on commodity boards the night the blossoms opened.

radio_hooks: Orbital apple orchards report critical blossom drop as pollination deadline looms.
Commercial agricultural syndicates petition station magistrate for emergency livestock seizure powers.
Independent apiary breeders picket commercial dome entrance protesting forced hive transfers.

voice_direction.apiary_matron: Soft-spoken, melodic, and stubborn. Speaks of her bees as living children and refuses to raise her voice regardless of threats.
voice_direction.orchard_steward: Earnest, soil-stained, and distressed. Speaks with reverence about founding trees planted by his grandparents and pleads for their survival.
voice_direction.commercial_grower: Rapid, abrasive, and metric-obsessed. Spits out calorie yields and contract deadlines, dismissing historical trees as sentimental luxuries.

title: The Quarantine Seed Cargo
logline: An automated agricultural inspection station flags a priceless heirloom seed pod as a biological bioweapon, sparking an armed standoff between paranoid sanitation wardens and desperate farmers.

roles.description: Station sanitation chief; obsessive, terrified of contagions, desperate to follow biosecurity checklists.
Pioneer farm delegate; weathered, furious, clutching generation-old planting records for the seized seed.
A heavily armed quarantine patrol cutter with biohazard incinerator beams.
The union of independent hydroponic and soil farmers across the outer belt.
A sealed orbital decontamination bay where incoming cargo is scanned with chemical analyzers.
The central pressurized vault where the system's planting crops are stored.

public_situation: Quarantine alert sirens blare at {role:inspection_dock} as armed sanitation cutters impound a courier shipment containing heirloom planting seed pods.
private_truth: The seeds were harvested from an uncatalogued moon where high sulfur levels altered the husk proteins, triggering false-positive alerts on automated nerve-toxin scanners.

beats.public_change: Sanitation buoys around {role:inspection_dock} flash purple biohazard warnings, ordering all commercial vessels to keep clear.

missions.reason: Scan the bio-scanner calibration logs to discover why the automated alarms classified non-toxic heirloom squash seeds as a neurotoxin.
missions.private_fact: The seeds were harvested from an uncatalogued moon where high sulfur levels altered the exterior husk proteins.

beats.public_change: Automated incinerator exhausts on the inspection dock begin pre-heating, preparing to purge the impounded cargo hold with plasma.

missions.reason: Deliver fine silicate sand to pack decontamination scrubbers around the quarantine pod in case the spores breach containment.
missions.private_fact: He witnessed an uncontrolled agricultural blight on his home world twenty years ago that killed half his family.

beats.public_change: A rogue decontamination drone malfunctions, jettisoning the seed canister into space amidst high-energy containment fields.

missions.reason: An automated quarantine drone went berserk and ejected the seed canister into space; disable the drone and recover the canister.
missions.private_fact: The farmers pooled their entire year's cooperative savings to purchase this single heirloom pod.

beats.public_change: Farmers form an unarmed blockade around {role:colony_seed_bank} as the warden brings armed sanitation bailiffs to seize the pod.

missions.reason: Courier the recovered seed canister past the sanitation barricades to the central agricultural vault.
missions.private_fact: The warden will face severe administrative tribunal penalties if he releases an uncertified cargo without executive sign-off.

player_choice.prompt: The seed canister is intact. The automated analyzers claim it is a Level-4 pathogen, while spectroscopic tests prove it is edible grain. The warden stands with his finger on the thermal purge.

options.label: Present the chemical proof to force the warden to lift the quarantine and plant the heirloom crop
Allow the warden to incinerate the seed pod to eliminate any theoretical contagion risk
Broker a test planting inside an isolated micro-dome under joint guard to satisfy both sides

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot proves the husk proteins are benign and forces the release of the cargo.
resolutions.summary: The heirloom seeds are planted across thirty farms, yielding an abundant and sweet harvest. {role:quarantine_warden} is reprimanded for paranoia.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved an automated quarantine sensor was terrified of squash, saving a system's planting crop.

resolutions.reached_by: The warden incinerates the pod out of an abundance of caution.
resolutions.summary: The seed pod is vaporized in the plasma incinerator. The station remains safely sterile, but {role:planters_league} faces economic ruin and famine.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers an isolated test planting under joint scientific guard.
resolutions.summary: A trial crop blooms safely under joint monitoring. Both the farmers and inspectors celebrate an immaculate, contagion-free harvest.

loose_threads.detail: The automated quarantine scanner was running a private security firmware patch installed without station oversight.
Underwriters placed an emergency biosecurity indemnity rider on the seed transport three days before departure.
Handwritten agricultural journals in the elder's footlocker cite three generations of successful harvest with the flagged seed.

radio_hooks: Station quarantine authority impounds agricultural transport citing anomalous bio-scanner alerts.
Independent farmers union stages sit-in at customs gates demanding release of certified seed shipments.
Sanitation bureau defends zero-tolerance contamination protocols amid public outcry.

voice_direction.quarantine_warden: Fast, jittery, and clinical. Repeats biohazard containment regulations by rote and wipes his comm console every few minutes.
voice_direction.agrarian_elder: Loud, incredulous, and exasperated. Alternates between bitter outrage and mocking disbelief at the idea that his grandmother's squash seeds could exterminate a station.

title: The Famine Relief Convoy
logline: A system-wide crop blight forces three star systems to bid on a single relief convoy of synthetic grain, sparking armed interdiction when the convoy's destination is abruptly changed.

roles.description: Master of the bulk grain transport fleet; exhausted, stoic, under orders to deliver whatever food survives.
Administrator of an industrial mining system facing imminent starvation; desperate, prepared to seize the fleet.
Governor of a densely populated residential hub whose children are on half-rations; pleading, armed.
A heavily armed private picket cruiser protecting the grain haulers.
The intersystem charitable food relief council organizing emergency grain allocations.
The regional union of deep-space extraction colonies facing starvation.
The central grain silos in the departure star system where the fleet loads.
An intermediate deep-space jump gate where regional lanes diverge.

public_situation: Three star systems face imminent winter starvation as a single convoy of grain haulers prepares to jump from {role:staging_depot} with food enough for only one population.
private_truth: Two of the convoy's four primary cargo holds were infested with grain weevils before departure, cutting actual viable flour tonnage in half.

beats.public_change: Dockworkers in {role:staging_depot} load grain sacks under armed marine escort as crowds gather along the perimeter fences.

missions.reason: Mine and deliver pure water ice to chill the grain hauler cargo holds, preventing warm rot during interstellar transit.
missions.private_fact: Two of the grain holds were already spoiled by weevils before loading, cutting true delivery volume by half.

beats.public_change: The convoy reaches {role:transit_waypoint} as rival communications channels broadcast frantic bidding wars for the cargo.

missions.reason: Scan the convoy's lead hauler transponders to determine whether the route has been altered away from the mining colonies.
missions.private_fact: The magistrate has authorized armed corsairs to interdict the fleet if the course diverts toward the residential hub.

beats.public_change: A mutinous escort vessel jams gate frequencies, attempting to hijack the convoy and divert it toward family habitats.

missions.reason: A rogue defense cruiser has seized the navigational beacon to reroute the grain; disable its engines to restore convoy control.
missions.private_fact: The cruiser captain hails mid-fight offering fifty thousand credits to escort the grain to the residential hub where his own family lives.

missions.reason: Recover the master gate jump cipher from the damaged cruiser to clear the fleet for departure.
missions.private_fact: The commodore knows there is not enough grain to keep both systems from rioting.

beats.public_change: Desperate mining gunboats form an armed interdiction line across the final gate pylon, demanding full delivery.

missions.reason: Armed miner strike craft surround the jump gate demanding the grain; destroy the blockade vanguard to force a passage.
missions.private_fact: The miners have eaten nothing but nutrient paste for forty cycles.

missions.reason: Transmit the final routing telemetry to commit the convoy to its destination star system.
missions.private_fact: Whoever receives this grain will survive the winter; whoever does not will face seventy percent infant mortality.

player_choice.prompt: The jump gate is open. The fleet carries twenty thousand tons of grain. The pilot holds the terminal routing beacon.

options.label: Route the convoy to the mining colonies to save the workers and prevent a regional raw materials collapse
Route the convoy to the densely populated residential hub to save civilian families and children
Force a split jump, dividing the remaining grain equally between both systems on half-rations

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot commits the routing beacon to the mining colonies.
resolutions.summary: The grain arrives at the mining belt, keeping ore production alive. The residential hub suffers catastrophic famine, leaving lasting bitterness across the sector.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot fought through an orbital blockade to bring emergency grain to freezing asteroid miners.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot commits the routing beacon to the civilian habitat hub.
resolutions.summary: The residential hub receives the grain, feeding hundreds of thousands of civilians. The unsupplied mining colonies shut down from starvation, crashing regional industry.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces an equal split of the remaining grain between both systems.
resolutions.summary: Both systems receive half-rations. Strict rationing averts mass starvation across the sector, and the two rival governments form a joint relief committee.

resolutions.reached_by: The jump link fails or the miners board the haulers by force.
resolutions.summary: Armed clashes rupture the cargo haulers at the jump gate. The grain is vaporized in vacuum, condemning both star systems to catastrophic starvation.

loose_threads.detail: The original bill of lading for the relief fleet was stamped with forty thousand tons by a broker who fled before launch.
Grain call options in the destination systems were bought up by an anonymous syndicate thirty days before the blight struck.
The hull numbering on {role:convoy_escort_cruiser} matches a naval vessel decommissioned and sold for scrap five cycles ago.

radio_hooks: Intersystem relief council dispatches emergency grain convoy following widespread frontier crop failure.
Industrial mining systems declare state of emergency as food reserves dwindle to single digits.
Transit authorities deploy heavy security along regional jump gates to deter pirate interception.

voice_direction.convoy_commodore: Steady, weathered, and hollow. Speaks with the flat authority of someone who knows people will die regardless of his orders.
voice_direction.mining_magistrate: Rough, desperate, and threatening. His voice cracks with panic as he describes starving drillers subsisting on industrial grease.
voice_direction.habitat_governor: Polite, desperate, and pleading. Uses bureaucratic etiquette that steadily frays as he begs for civilian lives.
